metadata.description: Deploys the Financial MCP Server to Azure Container Apps using the prebuilt public image from GHCR. Exposes the MCP endpoint over HTTPS at /mcp.
Name of the Container App (also used to name the environment and logs workspace).
Azure region. Defaults to the resource group's region.
Container image to deploy. Defaults to the public GHCR image published by CI.
Bearer token for MCP_AUTH_MODE=static. Optional when mcpAuthMode=oauth.
Authentication mode for streamable-http.
Application log level.
Optional. SerpAPI key for news/market data tools.
Optional. Alpha Vantage API key (reserved; stock quotes currently use yfinance).
Optional. Telegram bot token for alerts.
Optional. Telegram chat/user id for alerts.
Optional. Reachable Ollama URL for the news summarizer (e.g. https://my-ollama:11434).
Summarizer provider backend.
Optional. OpenAI API key for summarizer when using openai or auto mode.
Optional. OpenAI model name for summarizer.
Optional. OpenAI-compatible base URL override.
OIDC issuer URL used when mcpAuthMode=oauth.
Optional extra issuers for token validation (space-separated), e.g. sts.windows.net tenant issuer.
Optional OIDC JWKS URL override.
OIDC audience accepted by the MCP server.
Space-separated required scopes for JWT validation in OAuth mode.
Optional space-separated scopes advertised by MCP metadata; set full Entra scope (api://.../mcp.tools) to avoid resource/scope mismatch in strict clients.
Public MCP server URL used as OAuth resource server metadata URL.
Enable built-in OAuth broker for Claude + Entra resource/scope translation.
Optional broker issuer origin, e.g. https://<host>. Defaults to MCP resource origin.
Optional Entra client ID override for broker authorize/token requests.
Optional Entra client secret override for broker token requests.
Optional full Entra API scope requested by broker, e.g. api://<api-app-id>/mcp.tools.
